Getting Around: Directions

100Ls Shadowing Material · Lesson M2-06  ·  ← 上一课
📄 Full Script — Dialogue
0:00 / 0:00
速度：
Mark
Excuse me — could you tell me how to get to the Natural History Museum?
Local
Sure! You're not far. Head down this street for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic lights.
Mark
Left at the lights, got it. Is it far from there?
Local
Not at all. You'll see a big park on your right. The museum is just past the park — you can't miss it.
Mark
How long does it take on foot?
Local
About ten minutes. Or you could take the subway — Central Station is right behind you.
Mark
I'll walk, I think. Thanks so much!
Local
No problem. Have fun!
Mark：打扰一下——请问去自然历史博物馆怎么走？
Local：当然！您离得不远。沿着这条街走两个街区，然后在红绿灯处左转。
Mark：在红绿灯左转，明白了。从那里远吗？
Local：一点都不远。您会在右边看到一个大公园，博物馆就在公园过去——很好找的。
Mark：步行要多久？
Local：大约十分钟。或者您可以坐地铁——中央站就在您身后。
Mark：我想走过去。非常感谢！
Local：不客气。祝您玩得开心！

🔗 Connected Speech
"how to get to"
/haʊtəˈɡetə/
Reduction
Both "to" weaken to /tə/; the phrase flows as one unit.
"turn left at"
/tɜːrn left ət/
Reduction
"at" weakens to /ət/ before consonants.
"can't miss it"
/kɑːnt mɪsɪt/
Linking
Final /t/ + "it" link; /t/ of miss links to /ɪt/.
"how long does it"
/haʊlɒŋdəzɪt/
Reduction
"does" weakens to /dəz/ in unstressed position.
"right behind you"
/raɪt bɪˈhaɪnjuː/
Linking
behind+you link; /d/ connects to /j/.
